notes.title: Team-based spaceship battler Dreadnought launches on PS4
notes.notes:
Dreadnought, the free-to-play multiplayer game about big spaceships which don't get along, has moved out of open beta and launched on PlayStation 4.

Arriving in the launch build are voice chat, Trophies and aim assist, and there's still a lot to do. "It's been a fun, crazy beta experience," read an announcement on the Dreadnought website. "The entire team is incredibly excited to share Dreadnought with more console players around the world.

"Expect more awesome game updates as we kick things into development overdrive. January's patch is set to bring tons of long-requested balance improvements. Beyond that, expect to see custom games - a feature that allows you to set up matches with your friends in private, no-holds-barred arenas - and even further down the line, a huge content patch full of feedback-focused features like an overhaul to the module UI, a redesigned game reticle HUD as well as an improved tech tree progression experience that gives you more freedom when unlocking items.

Read more…

notes.title: Xbox One X Giveaway FAQ
notes.notes:
Do NOT delete your Steam receipt for Dreadnought Sol, instead forward it to our customer service mail: DevTeam@TheSherrinford.com 

FAQ

[b]What edition is it?[/b] 
XBox One X Console, 1 TB - Standard Edition (not bundled with any game that we know of)

[b]When is the winner announced?[/b]
Winner will be announced Dec 24th 2017

[b]I bought Dreadnought Sol as a gift, can I still participate?[/b]
Of course, as long as you forward the original receipt from the game you will be taken into consideration.

[b] Can I provide more than ONE receipt, so I have double the chance? [/b]
NO,sorry,  we are only accepting one receipt from each player in order to simplify the cheat detection.

[b] How will you contact the winner? [/b]
We will reply to the email that sent the winner receipt and then we will make the announcement through the Steam product page and Forum.

[b] I bought the game on retail and happened to just find this announcement on Steam, am I eligible?[/b]
Yes, we don't require your receipt but the unique serial number printed in the inside of your box. Everything else still applies

[b] I happen to live all the way to Australia, whatchu gonna do about it. Mate? [/b]
We are currently working really hard in an insurance solution that allows us to ship safely via air cargo to Oceania, until further notice we can't take Australian players into consideration.

notes.title: UI Overhaul
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30963669/56f3f31a7fef6ed5c182bff295093de983a82f9d.png[/img]

The new patch includes quite a few aesthetic improvements and a HUD overhaul.  
The HUD was reworked by condensing all the information regarding the Dreadnought shields, integrity and player level, as well as current galaxy.

- HUD length no longer occupies 45% of screen width, instead it is drawn over 20% of screen width.

- Dreadnought's integrity is represented numerically in addition to the dynamic bar.

-Level progress is represented more prominently with graphic quarters as well as EXP left to level up and current EXP gathered.

- Secondary Weapon selection has new icons and configuration on the HUD, mainly regarding a change in abstraction level and information clarity on  how much ammo is left to the player.


We'd love to hear from you.
Godspeed Commander.

notes.title: Content Patch #1
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30963669/e0c52954f95f53dfc1fb39ebbbec531ff98a1c74.png[/img]

Last Friday we released a little patch  in response of a community achievement milestone.  We introduced a new ship a little ahead of schedule so you all have extra fun  while we release Update 1. 

We will keep releasing new ships and content in a constant basis as well as addressing balancing issues or content adjustments suggested by you. For now it is up to you to unlock the new ship.!

Patch Notes:
 -Adjusted visibility in Dark Galaxies
-Increased Minelayers cooldown on Battle Warp.
-Bucentaur Class Dreadnought's MAC cannon has increased penetration.
-Victory Class Dreadnought's Railgun was buffed.

Godspeed Commander.

notes.title: Launch and Roadmap.
notes.notes:
[b]Dreadnought Sol[/b] launches officially tomorrow (Hurray!). It has been a long and winding road and I want to take a moment from the pre-launch frenzy here at the office to thank everybody that made this happen.

-If you were one of the Beta Testers, thank you for being with us and giving us your time unconditionally (even when that time a patch made two testers try to choke each other)

-If you are one of the many, many, many people that wishlisted this game. Thank you,  you helped us go through the final mile.

-If you were in Quebec City this summer and cheered us along. Thank you, you made everything 100x better.

Dreadnought Sol has  evolved continuously through it's development only for the better, thanks  to the continuous feedback from our players. We made a game we all enjoy to play and share with our friends and we know you will too. But this was only possible because we respect our players, we respect their intelligence, their time and their opinions. This doctrine, we feel, it's what's lacking in today's industry and was our mindset from day one.

The next thing down the roadmap is [b]Update 1.1[/b] which will expand the game with the following features:

[b]New Ships:[/b] Unlocked with in-game player actions and will change the player's mechanics as well provide different playstyles.

[b]Upgrades:[/b] Series of powerups that will grant the player additional abilities, obtainable by boss drops.

[b]New Stages:[/b] Especifically variations in the main run, regarding bosses.

We'll see you soon.
Godspeed Commander!
